radiusSource: Radius 0.960 (0.940 to 0.979) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 667,756 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.912 (0.872 to 0.952) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5545 +/- 4.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2343647384368388608: teff_gspphot 5544.7617 K (16th-84th percentiles 5539.675-5548.166), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
